authorization.request: DSH STORE 给出审核建议；固定来源仍可交由 DSH Desktop 官方插件管理器最终检查、安装并回报结果。用户已要求推送发布。

objective: 修复 DSH Desktop 中大量 Catalog blocked 条目的 Store 前置拦截。Catalog 保留复核状态和建议；用户逐次确认后，符合固定 GitHub 来源与安全路径约束的条目交由 DSH 官方 inspect/installBundle，并以 Desktop 结果为安装状态。

change.scope: 仅变更 DSH Desktop 内的 Marketplace 面板；不放宽 Web/Store 自主管理操作或 Catalog approved 准入。
change.desktopInstall: blocked 条目通过 canonical GitHub、40 位 Commit、有效包名、entry IDs、非官方命名空间、安全 installPath/manifestPath 与非受保护 entry ID 检查后，显示交由 DSH 检查安装的入口；安全 Unicode 路径可用，来源 provenance 标签和更新时间不作为安装门槛。明确展示 Store 审核原因与 updatePolicy。用户输入绑定当前包名和完整 Commit 的确认短语后，先调用 DSH inspect，只有 accepted 才调用 installBundle，按 DSH application/error 回报结果。
change.hardStops: unlisted、DSH Store 自身、@deepseek-ai/*、受保护 DSH entry ID、无效/浮动 GitHub 来源、错误安装路径或来源证据不全仍不可通过该按钮操作。
change.catalog: 不修改 Catalog status、admission 或 statusReason；permission/security signals 继续显示为 Store 建议，不声称 Desktop 安装等于安全审核。

commands.expected: all disposable Desktop cases pass, including DSH inspect rejection and accepted install result

gates: The Catalog stays blocked/unapproved and the Store displays the review reason; the button only submits a user-confirmed fixed source to DSH Desktop. Provenance labels and timestamps do not block a full-Commit source.
The official manager must return inspect status accepted before installBundle is called; rejected and unknown results never trigger an automatic retry.

Disposable tests cover malformed URL, floating/missing Commit, unsafe paths, safe Unicode install paths, protected package/entry IDs, changed source between confirmation and execution, manager rejection, successful/restart-required DSH results, and a blocked fixed-Commit entry whose provenance label/timestamp would previously have failed the Store gate.
Do not change real DSH Profiles, official DSH code, package admission status, candidate policy, or the Web Store operation gate.

Run npm run check before committing; merge only through exact-head CI-checked PR. After source merge, create a fresh Catalog release plan for 0.9.23 and verify GitHub Raw, Pages, dsh.store, and dsh-store.cn independently.

rollback.source: Revert this exact Store UI release through a CI-checked PR.
rollback.desktopProfile: This source change alone does not change a Desktop Profile. A user-confirmed DSH installation is a separate operation whose final status and recovery are owned by the official plugin manager.

healthCheck: Verify plan hashes and npm run check, then run disposable Desktop fixtures proving the full confirmation -> inspect -> installBundle -> result path. Exact-head CI and public listing readback remain separate release gates.

verification.staticMarketplaceBuild: passed: entries=872; Catalog manager remains 0.9.22 until separate post-merge Catalog release
verification.realDesktopAcceptance: not verified; requires updated DSH Desktop Store runtime
